critical_findings.title: All cf-* classes are undefined — the visual design layer does not exist
critical_findings.fix: Write the cf-* stylesheet (or adopt Tailwind 4 per stack) implementing the layout the class names already describe

critical_findings.title: Health dot online/offline states are visually identical
critical_findings.fix: Style .cf-dot-mark with success/danger colors paired with the existing text label

critical_findings.title: No layout: sidebar stacks above content, card grid never grids
critical_findings.fix: Flex two-pane body layout; cf-card-grid as auto-fill minmax grid

critical_findings.title: Stack diverges from mandated desktop profile (React 18, no Tailwind/shadcn/Zustand/Framer Motion/icons)
critical_findings.fix: Align dependencies to v2026.02 desktop-cross-platform profile; replace emoji brand with Lucide icon

critical_findings.title: Error states render the bare word 'Error' with no detail or retry
critical_findings.fix: Surface ApiError status/message and add a retry via queryClient.invalidateQueries

critical_findings.title: Hardcoded dark-only palette, no tokens, unstyled native controls on dark bg
critical_findings.fix: Define semantic CSS variables and style native controls against them; explicit light/dark strategy

critical_findings.title: Typography is browser defaults end to end — no scale, weights, or line-height
critical_findings.fix: Add a minimal type scale and tabular-nums for card counts

critical_findings.title: Nav buttons below comfortable target size with no active-state treatment
critical_findings.fix: Min-height 36-44px hit areas and a distinct is-active style

recommendations.action: Implement the cf-* stylesheet: two-pane layout, card grid, nav active state, styled controls
Style is-online/is-offline health dots with success/danger colors
Introduce semantic color tokens as CSS variables, keep the 13.9:1 text pair
Show ApiError detail with retry in dashboard error states
Align dependency stack to v2026.02 desktop profile (React 19, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Zustand 5)
Replace the ⚡ emoji brand mark with a Lucide icon

roadmap_suggestions.title: Desktop visual design system implementation
roadmap_suggestions.description: Write the missing stylesheet and tokens for the existing cf-* class vocabulary; the app currently ships unstyled

roadmap_suggestions.title: Design tokens and light/dark theming
roadmap_suggestions.description: Replace the hardcoded #e6e6e6/#1a1a1a pair with semantic CSS variables and an explicit theme strategy

roadmap_suggestions.title: Stack alignment to v2026.02 desktop-cross-platform profile
roadmap_suggestions.description: React 18→19, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Zustand 5, Lucide/Hugeicons icon set

roadmap_suggestions.title: State-change micro-motion pass
roadmap_suggestions.description: Pulse transitions for health dots and unread badge once styling lands; currently all state changes are invisible
